hero.eyebrow: Namaste from the land of the rising sun
hero.title: Mitra Japan
hero.body: Veg-safe food you can trust, phrases in your language, a visa that is simpler than you think, and a trip planned around the people you travel with.

persona.title: Tell us who you are, we will shape Japan around you.
persona.body: Pick one. Your choice tints the journey and seeds your trip plan.

family.label: Family with parents
family.hint: Gentle pace, lifts and rest stops, pure-veg comfort

honeymoon.label: Honeymoon
honeymoon.hint: Ryokan nights, onsen, Kyoto lanes at golden hour

student.label: Student
student.hint: Rail passes, hostels, smart budgets, anime streets

foodie.label: Foodie
foodie.hint: Shojin ryori, depachika halls, veg ramen hunts

spiritual.label: Spiritual
spiritual.hint: Koyasan temple stays, Nara, quiet mountain shrines

fears.title: Every worry has an answer.
fears.body: Each torii gate is one reason people hesitate. Pass through it and see what Mitra does about it.

food.a: Point your camera at a menu. We flag hidden fish stock (dashi), bonito, lard and gelatin before you order, matched to your diet.

language.a: Show a card written in Japanese from your own Hindi or Gujarati. Staff read it, nod, and cook accordingly.

visa.a: Five clear steps and a checklist you can tick off at home. We tell you what to keep ready before you apply.

foreign.a: Japan already prays to Saraswati, Ganesha and Lakshmi, under Japanese names. Keep walking.

shinkansen.name: Shinkansen
shinkansen.tagline: Tokyo to Kyoto in about 2 hours 15 minutes

kyoto.name: Kyoto
kyoto.tagline: Thousands of torii and quiet temples

matsuri.name: Matsuri
matsuri.tagline: Summer festival nights, lanterns and fireworks

explain.safe: Nothing in this dish breaks your diet.
explain.ask: Probably fine, but confirm with staff before ordering.
explain.avoid: Contains ingredients that break your diet.
explain.hidden: Looks safe on the menu, but the stock or fat gives it away.

steps: Passport valid for your whole trip, with blank pages
Visa application form and a recent passport photo
Recent bank statements and income tax returns
Apply via Japan eVISA or an authorised visa centre
visa.note: Rules change. Always confirm on the Embassy of Japan in India website before applying.

roots.title: You have met these gods before.
roots.body: Buddhism carried Indian deities to Japan more than a thousand years ago. They are still worshipped there today.
roots.mapCaption: Where to meet them in Japan today.

numbers.title: The gap is not price. It is confidence.

cta.title: Japan is ready for you.
cta.body: Tell our guide who is travelling and what you eat. Get a day-by-day route with trains, stays and a daily Food Confidence Score.
